threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'corner shop' instead of a 'local' and insist on waiting for traffic lights even when there’s no car in sight.
Heard a couple arguing about whether to take the night bus or just splash out on an Uber. Classic Peckham dilemma—sometimes the bus is a wild ride!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a giant inflatable duck floating in Neukölln Canal during summer. Only here would that seem perfectly normal.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find spontaneous street art festivals popping up overnight, turning forgotten walls into vibrant canvases before breakfast.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they can recite the BART delays like a litany and still say they’ll be 10 minutes late for tacos on 24th.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus yesterday that had a guy narrating his life story on the way to work—told us about his 'big plans' and somehow turned it into a therapy session.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think Gràcia's all about the plaça—miss the hidden alleys where locals grab their morning café and gossip about last night's fútbol.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell a newcomer by their bewildered look when the tram stops unexpectedly. They still don't know it never runs on time!

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of 'the Underground.' The locals love correcting you at the first pub quiz!
Caught a night bus from Brixton and overheard a couple arguing about who left the last slice of pizza on their kitchen counter. Classic night bus drama.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a guy serenading a streetlamp with an off-key rendition of 'Wonderwall' at 3 AM, I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only here do the U-Bahn stations feel like art galleries. I saw a full-blown exhibition in Görlitzer Bahnhof the other day!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local won’t bother waiting for the Muni when they spot a random scooter left on the sidewalk—just hop on and go.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 late last night; it stopped at every red light but the driver blasted a 90s hip-hop playlist. The vibe was unexpectedly nostalgic.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just waltz into any plaça and find a quiet spot. But locals know the true gems are tucked away in the side streets, away from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still say 'gràcies' instead of 'merci' after a café. You can almost see their excitement about the city, even if the locals have long moved on.
